code: library(fastperm) # eight matched pairs; the second covariate is skewed (fibonacci), so the # permutation law of Q is non-normal and the Gaussian tail drifts scores <- cbind(rep(c(1, 2), 8) + rep(0:7, each = 2) * 0.4,                 c(rbind(rep(1, 8), c(2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21, 34, 55)))) strata <- rep(1:8, each = 2) # treat the high-score unit in five of the eight pairs (a moderate imbalance) z <- rep(0, 16) for (b in 1:8) z[if (b <= 5) 2 * b else 2 * b - 1] <- 1 # Gaussian (M1) versus the non-normal permutation saddlepoint (M2) fastperm_spa_quadratic(scores, z, strata, method = "gaussian")$p.value #> [1] 0.05205406 res <- fastperm_spa_quadratic(scores, z, strata, method = "saddlepoint") c(lugannani_rice = res$p.value, r_star = res$p.value.rstar) #> lugannani_rice         r_star  #>     0.02712069     0.02712045

text: scores numeric matrix per-unit scores (units x representations). treatment 0/1 vector; per-stratum sums fix treated counts. strata factor vector stratum labels, length rows scores. metric either string "cov" (use exact permutation covariance T, giving Hansen-Bowers omnibus statistic) symmetric positive-definite p x p matrix (example covariate covariance). method "gaussian" (M1: weighted-chi-square tail Gaussian approximation centred statistic, inverted Lugannani-Rice) "saddlepoint" (M2: non-normal permutation saddlepoint, carries true skewness higher cumulants permutation law tail). nodes number Gauss-Hermite nodes per dimension "saddlepoint" method (Hubbard-Stratonovich integral r-dimensional Gaussian expectation evaluated tensor quadrature). title: Saddlepoint tail probability of a quadratic form under the permutation null — fastperm_spa_quadratic
text: metric enters rotation R R R' = M^{-1}: exactly, Q = || R'(T - mu) ||^2, sum squares whose Gaussian-approximation weights eigenvalues rotated permutation covariance. "saddlepoint" method uses exact permutation CGF centred statistic via Hubbard-Stratonovich identity M_Q(theta) = E_{W ~ N(0, I_r)}[exp(K_e(sqrt(2 theta) W))], evaluated tensor Gauss-Hermite quadrature inverted Lugannani-Rice. tensor rule costs nodes^r, feasible small r (number representations); larger r needs sparse-grid/QMC engine, yet implemented. E[Q] method falls back Gaussian-d tail, accurate rejection region.

title: Saddlepoint tail probability of a quadratic form under the permutation null — fastperm_spa_quadratic
code: scores <- cbind(c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6), c(1, 1, 2, 2, 5, 9)) z <- c(0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1) # omnibus balance test (metric = the permutation covariance) fastperm_spa_quadratic(scores, z, rep(1, 6))$p.value #> [1] 0.1352993 # the non-normal permutation saddlepoint fastperm_spa_quadratic(scores, z, rep(1, 6), method = "saddlepoint")$p.value #> Warning: observed Q is at or beyond the saddlepoint's reliable range; falling back to the Gaussian-d tail. #> [1] 0.1352993
